items.description: Website Authority Checker is a tool that can retrieve a website's Moz Domain Authority, Moz Page Authority, Google PageRank, approximate age, and external equity links. Domain and page authority are calculated base on metrics like the number of linking root domains, the quality of incoming links, and so on. Website Authority Checker calculates website age instead of domain age, because it's the metric more relevant to SEO.

From their site: Yahoo! Site Explorer APIs provide access to information about your site from the Yahoo! Site Explorer service. These APIs help you better understand your traffic and usage -- querying for the pages in the Yahoo! index and the sites linking into a site.
